fact: The Bureau of Statistics and Census issued Statistical Book 2023, its 28th annual edition, whose tables of Libyan births and deaths 2018-2022 are sourced to the Civil Status Authority; it also carries education and health tables. The PDF sits under a January 2026 upload path, and the book states no publication date.
title: الكتاب الإحصائي 2023 / Statistical Book 2023
publisher: مصلحة الإحصاء والتعداد / Bureau of Statistics and Census
why_not: no-development: the tables only name the Civil Status Authority as source, which study §2 does not count, and the only date is the upload path's
